<!--

issue_context.title: Recurring request to reconfigure Samsung Smart TV after a few hours
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Hello,

Home Assistant regularly asks for Samsung Smart TV reconfiguration despite the correction https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/67632#issuecomment-1061513129.
This was already the case after several days before version 2022.3.0 but since this version it happens several times a day. The new fix installed in the directory custom_components\samsungtv reduces the recurrence but does not solve the problem.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.3.0 and after

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2022.2.0

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Samsung Smart TV

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/samsungtv/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?



### Additional information
